displayName: Top-tier legendary material supply rate by playstyle
description: Measures per-hour acquisition of the two Tier-5 / 'legendary' crafting materials added in task #134 — Wyrdforged Core (apex Wyrd boss drop, Maw Borderlands + Ashen Reach pools, weight 1) and Starforged Ingot (Caervorn-deep + frost-giant boss drop, weight 1). Expected outcome: these materials are deliberately scarce — acquiring enough to fully kit out all 7 armor/weapon slots should take focus-farming, not incidental picks. Combat-heavy and balanced playstyles should still see 0.3-1.0 per hour at danger 8+; craft-heavy and enchanting-focused should see essentially zero. If a 40h balanced sim produces zero of either material it is a content bug — bump the weight on the offending loot-tables pool entry. NOTE: this playbook is an economy-sim spec (kind=economy). It is consumed by the economy evaluator; today the file is a content contract that the economy-sim command can load. Acceptance is via the content-layer test that verifies every itemName referenced here exists in loot-tables dropPools or monsters.json bossDrops.

materialSources.comment: Which loot/boss paths each material is produceable through.

perHourExpectation.craft-heavy: <0.1/hr (must buy from other players or pivot)

alerts.zeroBalanced40h: If balanced 40h produces zero of either material, double the weight on the offending biome pool entry (biome-wyrd / biome-mountain / biome-desert).
alerts.floodCombatHeavy: If combat-heavy 40h exceeds 50 of a single material, recipes are trivially satisfiable — halve weight or require more per recipe.
